rawquery.query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') AS reportPeriod, COALESCE(NULLIF(profileId, ''), 'unknown') AS profileId, MAX(profileName) AS profileName, COALESCE(NULLIF(appCode, ''), 'unknown') AS appCode, MAX(appName) AS appName, COALESCE(NULLIF(agentCode, ''), 'unknown') AS agentCode, MAX(agentName) AS agentName, MAX(provider) AS provider, MAX(model) AS model, COUNT(*) AS interactions, SUM(inputTokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(outputTokens) AS outputTokens, SUM(totalTokens) AS totalTokens, SUM(cachedTokens) AS cachedTokens, SUM(reasoningTokens) AS reasoningTokens, SUM(CASE WHEN isEstimated='true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS estimatedInteractions FROM ai_agent_billing_usage WHERE createdAt BETWEEN '$startdate' AND '$enddate' AND ('$profileId'='' OR profileId='$profileId') AND ('$appCode'='' OR appCode='$appCode') AND ('$agentCode'='' OR agentCode='$agentCode') GROUP BY reportPeriod, profileId, appCode, agentCode ORDER BY reportPeriod ASC LIMIT $page,$size
